name: Sharp Shrimp 7
author: javierBarroso
description: Neon gradient rounded sky-blue toggle switch that toggles on and off when clicked.
howItWorks: Clicking it toggles it: background-color changes from #ccc to #2196F3, transform becomes rotate(90deg), transform becomes translateX(1.5em). On focus, box-shadow becomes 0 0 1px #2196F3.
